try:
		"""
		Devolver eventos de statehistory solapados con un rango y recortados al rango.
	
		Color:
		  - '#6ABCE2' si ReasonCode = 1001 (prioridad máxima).
		  - '#FF8A8A' si RecordDowntime = 1 en statereason.
		  - '#FFFF8A' si PlannedDowntime = 1 (y RecordDowntime != 1).
		  - '#8AFF8A' si ambos = 0.
	
		Inputs:
			value["dbConnection"] (str)
			value["startDateTime"] (datetime)
			value["endDateTime"] (datetime)
	
		Returns:
			Dataset: [itemId, ID, startDate, endDate, label, color, opacity]
		"""
		# Initialization of variables
		db = value["dbConnection"]
		startDateTime = value["startDateTime"]
		endDateTime = value["endDateTime"]
	
		stateHistoryTable = mes_core.model.statehistoryTable(db)
	
		columns = [
			"NodeID AS itemId",
			"ID",
			# start recortado al inicio del rango
			"CASE WHEN StartDateTime < ? THEN ? ELSE StartDateTime END AS startDate",
			# end recortado al fin del rango (considerando abiertos)
			(
				"CASE WHEN COALESCE(EndDateTime, GETDATE()) > ? THEN ? "
				"ELSE COALESCE(EndDateTime, GETDATE()) END AS endDate"
			),
			"ReasonName AS label",
			# color: prioridad 1001 > RecordDowntime > PlannedDowntime > verde
			(
				"CASE "
				" WHEN ReasonCode = 1001 THEN '#6ABCE2' "
				" WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM statereason sr "
				"               WHERE sr.ID = statehistory.StateReasonID "
				"                 AND sr.RecordDowntime = 1) THEN '#FF8A8A' "
				" WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM statereason sr "
				"               WHERE sr.ID = statehistory.StateReasonID "
				"                 AND sr.PlannedDowntime = 1) THEN '#FFFF8A' "
				" ELSE '#8AFF8A' "
				"END AS color"
			),
			"0.5 AS opacity"
		]
	
		# Solape: [Start, End] con [startDateTime, endDateTime]
		where_clause = (
			"StartDateTime < ? "
			"AND COALESCE(EndDateTime, GETDATE()) > ?"
		)
	
		# Orden de parámetros:
		# 1-2: CASE startDate
		# 3-4: CASE endDate
		# 5-6: WHERE de solape
		where_args = [
			startDateTime, startDateTime,
			endDateTime,   endDateTime,
			endDateTime,   startDateTime
		]
	
		ds = stateHistoryTable.selectCustom(columns=columns, where_clause=where_clause, where_args=where_args)
		return ds
	
	except:
		import system
		return system.dataset.toDataSet(['itemId','ID','startDate','endDate','label','color','opacity'], [])
